customManagers.description: Renovate leaves the paired sha256 alone, so a bump fails its checksum until someone refreshes it
Renovate's built-in managers skip the version inputs of the mise feature and mise-action

packageRules.description: prek-action's prek-version and mise.toml pin the same prek, so one pull request bumps both
ansible-lint's hook and mise.toml pin the same ansible-core, so one pull request bumps both
The Ansible stand-in runs the NanoPi-NEO3's Debian major release, which apt never changes, so only point releases reach it
mise never builds ansible-core's dependencies from source, and PyYAML publishes no Python 3.15 wheels, so ansible-core can't install on 3.15 until they ship
The devcontainer and CI must run the same mise, so one pull request bumps every pin
Provider and Terraform updates change every later plan, bootstrap's included

Merging a change to any of terraform-apply.yml's paths applies it. One matching file holds the whole pull request, because Renovate automerges a branch only when every upgrade in it qualifies. Keep in step with terraform-apply.yml's paths
Lock file maintenance merges only when terraform-plan.yml confirms its plan changes nothing. Keep this rule last so it overrides both holds above
